requirements.label: IB · Mother Tongue Language and exemption
requirements.details: An SL or HL pass in Mother Tongue Language A or B can fulfil the requirement. NTU also recognises specified Singapore GCE results, Mother Tongue Language in lieu and MOE exemptions. Applicants may still apply if they do not meet it. Admitted students without an approved exemption must fulfil the requirement before graduation.
